title: Generate Parentheses
description: Generate every well-formed parentheses string containing n pairs.
outputFormat: Print the valid strings in lexicographic order separated by spaces.

examples.explanation: These are all valid arrangements of three pairs.

title: Subsets
description: Return every subset of an array of distinct integers.
outputFormat: Print sorted subsets, one per line; print [] for the empty subset.

examples.explanation: A two-element set has four subsets.

title: Permutations
description: Return every permutation of an array of distinct integers.
outputFormat: Print permutations in lexicographic order, one per line.

title: Combination Sum
description: Return all unique combinations whose values sum to target. A candidate may be selected repeatedly.
outputFormat: Print sorted combinations, one per line.

title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
description: Return every letter combination represented by a string of telephone keypad digits.
outputFormat: Print combinations in lexicographic order separated by spaces.

examples.output: ad ae af bd be bf cd ce cf
examples.explanation: Combine each letter for 2 with each letter for 3.

title: Word Search
description: Determine whether a word can be formed from horizontally or vertically adjacent cells without reusing a cell.

examples.explanation: The word can be traced through adjacent cells.

title: Palindrome Partitioning
description: Partition a string so every substring in each partition is a palindrome.
outputFormat: Print sorted partitions, joining parts with spaces and printing one partition per line.

title: N-Queens II
description: Return the number of distinct ways to place n queens on an n by n chessboard so no queens attack each other.
outputFormat: Print the number of valid arrangements.

examples.explanation: There are two valid arrangements for four queens.

title: Restore IP Addresses
description: Insert three dots into a digit string to produce every valid IPv4 address.
outputFormat: Print valid addresses in lexicographic order separated by spaces.

examples.explanation: These are the two valid IPv4 addresses.

title: Combination Sum III
description: Return all combinations of k distinct numbers from 1 through 9 whose sum equals n.
inputFormat: Two space-separated integers k and n
outputFormat: Print sorted combinations, one per line.

examples.explanation: 1, 2, and 4 are distinct and sum to 7.
